lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible; spacing is approximately equidistant through the mid-torso, with slightly decreased spacing between the final three posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two posterior-most lines (7th and 8th from the shoulder) are truncated, terminating at the mid-flank level rather than extending to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct white spots are located in a sparse cluster on the lower haunch, positioned approximately halfway between the dorsal line and the hind knee joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate spiral; originating with a lateral-posterior vector, curving through a 180-degree vertical arc, and terminating in a superior-medial orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 10-12% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Features include a prominent white chevron mark between the eyes, two white spots on the lower mandible, a white throat patch, and a long dark hair fringe along the ventral midline.
